stances.summary: Flags concerning 5th Circuit decisions favoring Trump immigration powers and gun restrictions
stances.quote:
Likely en banc decisions from the 5th Circuit soon:

1. Trump can use the Alien Enemies Act to summarily deport Venezuelans

2. A $1.7 trillion bill enacted in 2022 is invalid in its entirety because of proxy voting

3. The whole federal statute barring criminals from owning guns

stances.summary: Examines D.C. v. Heller as model for progressive constitutional advocacy, critiques originalism
stances.quote: For Slate's summer series By the People, I wrote about how D.C. v. Heller is both a paragon of popular constitutionalism and its own dark mirror. Progressives can learn real lessons from how it was won—if they ignore its bogus originalism and look at what really went down. slate.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump v. United States for granting presidential immunity from criminal prosecution
stances.quote: The Supreme Court invited exactly this when it held that the president's attempt to conduct "sham" "investigations" was a core executive power immune from all regulation, including criminal prosecution, in Trump v. United States.

stances.summary: Dismisses justice's Supreme Court ambitions and attention-seeking behavior
stances.quote: Obviously Ho is campaigning for a Supreme Court seat (that he'll never get), but I also think he has more broadly become totally addicted to attention. I find these rants increasingly dull and tedious and wonder if they're best just ignored.

stances.summary: Criticizes subject as pathological liar seeking attention
stances.quote: It's a point worth making but at SOME point we're going to have to accept that he's a pathological liar who makes shit up for attention and refuse to play the game, I think.

stances.summary: Exposes DoorDash lobbying against D.C. home rule and local tax authority
stances.quote:
DoorDash, in damage control mode, now claims it supports D.C. home rule and denies lobbying against it. 

Here’s the letter their lobbyist wrote to Rep. Comer supporting his bill to ban D.C. from ever imposing or increasing a tax or fee without congressional approval. hillheat.co

stances.summary: Clarifies earlier misstatement about fee amount to emphasize absurdity

stances.summary: Questions Trump's legal challenge to Yale's diversity admissions
stances.quote: The Trump administration sued Yale for its admissions policies (alleging too much diversity). Yale is negotiating with DOJ, whereas Harvard fought Trump. The former dean of Yale Law School thinks he knows the real reason why. slate.com/news-and-pol...

stances.summary: Criticizes ICE and DOJ detention policy as legally unfounded
stances.quote: Great news; yet another court finds that ICE and the DOJ were wrong to declare that Congress secretly mandated detention of millions of noncitizens in 1996 (specifically, anyone who entered unlawfully at some point in the past, no matter how long ago), and that no one had noticed

stances.summary: Criticizes ICE for violating due process by blocking self-deportation
stances.quote:
Here's a new one: ICE *prevented* a man from self-deporting by a June 11 deadline — he asked ICE to let him leave and had a one-way plane ticket for June 10.

Then ICE re-detained him because he missed the deadline. Due process violation, judge rules. storage.courtlistener.com/re
